2026_01_ARI_LAC.headline: Herbert’s quick-game structure tests Arizona’s pressure plan at SoFi
2026_01_ARI_LAC.paragraph1: Arizona enters SoFi trying to keep Justin Herbert from settling into Mike McDaniel’s quicker passing structure, while the Chargers have emphasized creating explosive gains without exposing their quarterback to the punishment he absorbed last season. The Cardinals also entered the opener managing Jeremiyah Love’s ankle and Josh Sweat’s knee. Arizona’s path is efficient early-down offense and disruptive pressure; Los Angeles can take control if Herbert stays clean and repeatedly attacks favorable coverage leverage.
2026_01_ARI_LAC.model_rationale: Los Angeles has the steadier path through quarterback efficiency and protection, while Arizona needs early-down success and consistent disruption to prevent the Chargers from controlling tempo.
